# Healio

> Healio is a comprehensive digital platform delivering daily medical news, free CME education, clinical guidance, and AI-powered clinical tools for healthcare professionals across all specialties.

Healio serves as a trusted resource for physicians and healthcare professionals, aggregating clinical research, FDA approvals, treatment updates, and continuing medical education across major medical specialties including cardiology, oncology, dermatology, neurology, and infectious disease. The platform combines traditional medical news with innovative AI tools built on verified medical sources to support clinical decision-making.

## Key Topics

- CME - Continuing Medical Education
- Clinical guidance and decision support
- Medical news and clinical updates
- FDA drug approvals
- Disease management
- Healthcare professionals
- Medical specialties
- Clinical research
- Treatment updates
- Specialty-specific news
- Healthcare policy
- Medical education
- Clinical research findings
- Drug approvals and safety
- Healthcare innovation

## Core Platform & Tools

- [Daily Medical News, Free CME and Clinical Guidance](https://www.healio.com): Healio homepage: medical news, CME education, clinical guidance for healthcare professionals
- [Free CME | Healio](https://www.healio.com/cme): Free CME credits and continuing education courses for healthcare professionals
- [Clinical Guidance for Physicians | Clinical Reference | Healio](https://www.healio.com/clinical-guidance): Comprehensive clinical reference for physicians with drug lookup and disease management
- [Healio AI: AI Tool Built on Trusted Medical Sources](https://www.healio.com/ai): Healio AI tool providing real-time clinical responses from verified medical sources

## Medical News & Updates

- [All Specialties News](https://www.healio.com/news): Aggregated medical news across all specialties with articles, videos, podcasts
- [Cardiology News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/cardiology): Cardiology news, clinical resources, and CME for cardiologists and physicians
- [Hematology & Oncology News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/hematology-oncology): Hematology and oncology news covering cancer treatment and FDA drug approvals
- [Dermatology News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/dermatology): Dermatology specialty news with clinical updates and treatment safety information
- [Neurology](https://www.healio.com/neurology): Neurology news covering Parkinson's disease and neurological disease management
- [Infectious Disease News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/infectious-disease): Infectious disease news with clinical guidelines and disease research updates

## Specialty Clinical News

- [Endocrinology News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/endocrinology): Endocrinology news covering FDA approvals, obesity treatment, and clinical updates
- [Gastroenterology News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/gastroenterology): Gastroenterology specialty news with clinical research and digestive health updates
- [Hepatology News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/hepatology): Hepatology news covering liver disease, hepatitis treatment, and clinical updates
- [Nephrology](https://www.healio.com/nephrology): Nephrology specialty news covering kidney disease and transplantation research
- [Allergy/Asthma News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/allergy-asthma): Allergy and asthma specialty news with clinical research and treatment updates
- [Orthopedics News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/orthopedics): Orthopedics news with surgical infection prevention and total knee arthroplasty updates

## Eye Care Specialties

- [Ophthalmology News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/ophthalmology): Ophthalmology news covering myopia control and eye care clinical research
- [Optometry News - Healio](https://www.healio.com/optometry): Optometry news covering myopia control, contact lenses, and eye care updates
